name: Calendar fills live with a booking toast
looks: An empty week-view calendar populates with small coloured appointment blocks across several days and times, landing on a stagger. A toast slides in from the corner announcing a new booking by the voice agent, and a counter beside it ticks up to its total.
build: variant-stack-reveal for the appointment blocks, each a tiny seeded offset settling into its exact grid cell; the toast slides/fades in on its own beat, and the counter uses live-readout-hud's no-ease text-set, counting to its final value as the toast lands.
sound: A soft cluster of ticks as blocks land, one confirm chime on the toast, and a rising tick under the counter.
prompt: Show the calendar filling itself: a grid of empty days gains appointment blocks one after another until the week looks genuinely busy, capped by a toast confirming a new booking and a running counter proving the total.
